notes: STAGE CONFLICT (the finding the W6 dispatch specifically asks for). The FY2025 annual report contains two internally inconsistent statements about this equipment, both preserved below as separate maturity_history entries, NOT reconciled: (1) the business-review narrative (p48) says the company 'has successfully developed wafer hybrid bonding, wafer temporary bonding, D2W TCB bonding equipment ... now delivered to multiple customers' (已成功开发了晶圆混合键合、晶圆临时键合、D2W TCB键合等设备 ...现已交付多家客户); (2) the same report's own R&D-project table (p36), under the project name '热压倒转键合设备开发' (a differently-named but equivalent TCB development project, explicitly glossed in the table's own purpose text as '自主研发热压倒装键合（TCB）设备'), reports 研发阶段：样机阶段 (prototype stage), with a stated forward target of only 1-2 standardized prototype units completing testing, reliability validation and customer trial, targeting a yield of >=99.9%. 'Delivered to multiple customers' and 'prototype stage, target 1-2 units, still at customer-trial' describe materially different points in the development cycle. I independently verified the same shape of conflict recurs in the FY2024 report (p47 narrative vs p35 R&D table, project name '晶圆热压键合设备开发', also 样机阶段) -- registered below as two further entries, making this a two-year-running inconsistency, not a one-off drafting slip. W13 RECORDS REVIEW (accept) by claude_w13_records_verifier: Name 'D2W TCB 键合' confirmed verbatim within the shared p48 excerpt (maxwell_fy2025, non-layout, stripped). category_id bonding_tcb is correct and appropriately specific: TCB is explicitly named ('自主研发热压倒装键合（TCB）设备', maxwell_fy2025 p36, confirmed via -layout row/stage pairing with 样机阶段), and bonding_tcb has no d2w/w2w children, so no further specificity is available or warranted. Two aliases are near-misses rather than fabrications: '热压倒装键合设备' drops the '（TCB）' parenthetical from the verbatim '热压倒装键合（TCB）设备'; '热压倒转键合设备' is a trivial truncation of the verbatim project name '热压倒转键合设备开发' (maxwell_fy2025 p36). notes:
CLASSIFICATION JUDGEMENT CALL: filed at bonding_hybrid_w2w (wafer-to-wafer), not bonding_hybrid_d2w. The source's own sentence structure distinguishes '晶圆混合键合' (wafer hybrid bonding) from 'D2W TCB 键合' (explicitly D2W) in the same list, which I read as implying the hybrid-bonding tool is wafer-level (W2W) rather than die-to-wafer -- but the filings never use the letters 'W2W' anywhere, so this is an inference from contrast, not a direct statement. Flagging for a future reviewer to correct if better evidence surfaces.

DELIBERATELY NOT MERGED: a same-FY2024-report R&D-project table (p35) lists a separate '熔融混合键合设备开发' (fusion/molten hybrid-bonding equipment development) project at 试产阶段 (trial production), but that project's own purpose text ties it explicitly to new display applications ('泛半导体行业目前对键合工艺需求加大，键合为主的工艺路线成为新型显示发展的热点...公司拟开发全自动熔融/混合键合设备') -- i.e. it is a DISPLAY-context hybrid/fusion bonding project, not this semiconductor-packaging platform. Not registered here. Likewise, FY2025 p12's '...针对 Micro LED 自主研发了...D2D 键合、混合键合等全套设备' names 'hybrid bonding' again but explicitly under the Micro LED display tool list, not the semiconductor-packaging section (p48) this platform draws on; also not merged in. Both exclusions follow the W6 dispatch's trap warning about the issuer's combined semiconductor-and-display business: the word 混合键合 recurs in both contexts in this issuer's own filings, and conflating them would misattribute a display-tool claim to a semiconductor platform. INTEGRATOR CORRECTION (1 October): moved from bonding_hybrid_w2w to the bonding parent. The reasoning for W2W was sound — the filing lists 晶圆混合键合 beside an explicitly die-to-wafer D2W TCB 键合 item, and Huazhuo’s filings do use 晶圆混合键合设备 for its wafer-to-wafer product against 芯片-晶圆混合键合设备 for die-to-wafer — but the inference was flagged as an inference, and this repository does not resolve a child category on one. Huazhuo’s SOI/POI series sits at this same parent for the same reason. The cost is that "hybrid" is lost at the parent, which is the actual finding: the taxonomy has bonding_hybrid_w2w and bonding_hybrid_d2w as siblings under bonding with no intermediate node for hybrid bonding whose side the source leaves unstated. That node is worth adding deliberately rather than mid-wave, and this platform should move under it when it exists. W13 RECORDS REVIEW (correct) by claude_w13_records_verifier: Name/category/maturity are all well-supported and I confirm the integrator's 1 October correction (bonding_hybrid_w2w -> bonding parent) is sound: I independently grepped data/categories.json and confirmed no 'bonding_hybrid' intermediate parent node exists above bonding_hybrid_w2w/bonding_hybrid_d2w, so 'bonding' is genuinely the only available node for 'hybrid bonding, side unstated' -- the record's own reasoning is checkable and correct. Alias finding: '晶圆混合键合设备' is a list-elision construction (source reads '晶圆混合键合、晶圆临时键合、D2W TCB键合等设备', sharing one trailing 等设备 across three items) -- acceptable, paralleling the name field's own construction. But alias '混合键合设备' is a genuine mis-sourced alias: the ONLY place this exact 6-character string appears contiguously in any of the three held Maxwell filings is inside '熔融混合键合设备开发' (maxwell_fy2024 p35, non-layout confirmed), which is the FY2024 R&D table's FUSION/molten hybrid-bonding project for Micro LED DISPLAY applications -- the exact project this record's own notes say is 'DELIBERATELY NOT MERGED' because it is a display-context, not semiconductor-packaging, claim. Keeping '混合键合设备' as an alias of this semiconductor platform borrows its only textual basis from the platform the notes themselves exclude. Removing it; '晶圆混合键合设备' alone is sufficient and properly sourced.

通过自主研发创新，公司重点攻关了高精密气浮平台、高功率高效率激光、SLM 空间光调制等关键技术，作为行业首创“磨划+键合整体解决方案”的设备供应商，迈为股份可提供封装成套工艺设备解决方案。经过持续的技术积累与工艺迭代，当前，公司晶圆磨划设备优势持续巩固。多款半导体装备已交付行业头部客户并实现稳定量产，在国内晶圆激光开槽设备、晶圆研抛一体机市场的占有率已稳居行业首位。
在半导体产业链中，先进的晶圆键合技术是推动器件微型化和更高集成度的关键环节。公司已成功开发了晶圆混合键合、晶圆临时键合、D2W TCB 键合等设备，不断提升产品在精度、稳定性、可靠性与智能化方面的水平，现已交付多家客户。
